passives.name: Unova’s Hotblooded Girl
passives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.) Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.
